purpose: Fresh paired complete-game test of a first eligible discard intervention; focused 2p development experiment, not the full multiplayer strength gate.

model.selection: Fixed original update79 parent derivative; not a winner selected from the new comparison.

eligibility: Exactly the first learner multi-choice discard per game with max public cities >= end threshold minus3. Other model actions unchanged.
pairing: Same fresh deals and all seats/rules for each arm. Public root identities, legal menus and original model proposals must match across arms before the intervention. Search RNG has a distinct seed stream; no live private seed/deck or outcome input.
tie_rule: Keep parent proposal if among tied winners; otherwise first engine-legal winner. Any cap invalidates the experiment; never score capped search as a defeat.
selection_rationale: All 46080 2p audit rollouts verified, zero caps; neural batch choices agree29/30 and economic27/30. Choose both continuations for this fresh test instead of picking a winner on the same audit data.

analysis.unit: Whole independent deals; preserve all seat/rule repeats. Overall and four rule cells. Marginal exploratory intervals, not multiplicity adjusted.

next_scope: If complete-game gain holds, test guidance/training across every2–6p/rule cell and independent opponents, then the unchanged reserved strength gate. No deployment from this test.
